answer: Grant weight only against collateral locked in an exclusive time-bound escrow, and reject any pledge that double-commits coin already securing another identity. One bankroll is a single reef of capital: locking it behind persona A leaves nothing for B. Splitting a plume of funds across a thousand fakes merely divides the same fixed pledge — each coin backs exactly one live identity at a time, never many. The real cost is foregone yield on every coin tied up, so a lotus of idle personas buys an operator no influence its locked bankroll didn't already command once.
